Companion Animal Travel Desk: Routine companion travel must be checked carefully so every passenger gets calm, clear support before departure. This section explains how the Companion Animal Travel Desk keeps animal travel smooth, safe, and easy to follow. Staff should greet each traveler in a friendly way, confirm the booking details, and make sure the companion animal's documents, carrier, and basic comfort needs are in order before the handoff to the welcome team. Guidance should be given in plain language, with steady reassurance, so passengers understand what will happen next and can prepare without stress.

When reviewing a case, staff should listen for special concerns, note any visible travel issues, and pass along only the information needed for boarding support. If a traveler arrives worried or unsure, the desk should slow things down, restate the key steps, and coordinate with the welcome team so the boarding process stays orderly. Aurelia Skyways expects dependable companion travel, so the desk must keep records tidy, speak consistently, and avoid guesswork. For anything that needs extra review or escalation, contact the senior coordinator for guidance.
